senses.gloss: f. (preced.) small, young, tender; lesser; a little.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 19:31">Targ. Gen. XIX, 31</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:1:14">Y. Ber. II, 4ᵇ</cite> <he>ז׳ לא … דרבה</he> the inferior does not greet the superior; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 2:5:4">Y. Shek. II, 47ᵃ</cite> top <he>דז׳</he> (not <he>ר׳ ז׳</he>).—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 3:5:6">Y. Snh. III, 21ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>משום דזעיר מיניה</he> in behalf of one his junior.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:1:6">Y. Keth. V, beg. 29ᶜ</cite> <he>ומר ז׳</he> and said something small (insignificant).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:1:6">Ib.</cite> <he>והדא היא ז׳</he> is this something small?; a. fr.—<cite ref="G00618"><he>זְעִירִין</he></cite>, <he>זְעֵירַיָּא</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 12:4">Targ. Y. Ex. XII, 4</cite>.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 115:13">Targ. Ps. CXV, 13</cite>; a. fr.—Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᵈ top <he>והוא שאיל לז׳</he> and he asked the inferior (scholars)?—Fem. <cite ref="G00598"><he>זְעֵירָן</he></cite>, <cite ref="G00603"><he>זְעֵירָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 104:25">Targ. Ps. CIV, 25</cite> (Ms. <cite ref="G00164"><he>זוטרתא</he></cite>).
